title: Multimedia Designer
jobDescription:
Group Company: Harbinger Group

Designation: Multimedia Designer (Storyline Developer)

Office Location: Siddhant


Position description:

Develop technically robust, engaging, and accessible digital learning experiences with Articulate Storyline 360 as the primary development platform. The role requires strong hands-on Storyline expertise, independent problem-solving, disciplined quality assurance, and the ability to convert approved storyboards into polished, LMS-ready courses.

Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop complete e Learning courses, modules, microlearning, simulations, assessments, and reusable templates primarily in Articulate Storyline 360.
  • Build basic to advanced interactions using layers, object states, triggers, variables, conditions, motion paths, lightboxes, question banks, and custom navigation.
  • Translate storyboards, scripts, visual specifications, and functional requirements accurately into working Storyline screens.
  • Configure course players, menus, resources, accessibility controls, completion rules, scoring, retries, and resume behavior according to project requirements.
  • Synchronize narration, on-screen text, animation, video, captions, and interaction timing.
  • Implement accessibility requirements, including keyboard navigation, logical focus order, alt text, captions/transcripts, readable contrast, visible focus states, and clear learner instructions.
  • Publish and test packages for SCORM 1.2/2004, x API, or other required LMS standards; troubleshoot tracking, bookmarking, media, browser, and performance issues.
  • Perform thorough self-QA covering content accuracy, trigger logic, interaction behavior, navigation, accessibility, visual consistency, and LMS functionality.
  • Prepare translation-friendly source files, integrate localized text/audio, and perform localization QA when required.
  • Create Storyline prototypes and proof-of-concepts, and contribute reusable components, templates, standards, and development best practices.
  • Use approved AI tools where useful for asset generation, narration, localization, coding support, or productivity, while validating accuracy, licensing, privacy, and quality.
Reporting Team
  • Reporting Designation: Manager Visual Design
  • Reporting Department: Digital Publishing

Educational qualifications preferred

  • Degree: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in digital learning, multimedia, technology, or a related discipline.

Required work experience

  • Industry: Relevant e Learning development experience, with substantial hands-on experience in Articulate Storyline 360.
  • ROLE: Storyline Developer
  • Years of experience: 3-5 years

Required Competencies:

  • Advanced hands-on expertise in Articulate Storyline 360 is essential.
  • Strong command of triggers, variables, conditions, layers, states, assessments, custom player behavior, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong storyboard interpretation, attention to detail, and practical visual-layout skills.
  • Working knowledge of instructional design, adult learning, usability, accessibility, responsive learning, and LMS publishing/testing.
  • Ability to estimate tasks, work independently, communicate risks early, and collaborate effectively with instructional designers, visual designers, QA, and project managers.

Required Knowledge:

Working knowledge of related tools such as Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, Lectora, Xyleme, audio/video editing tools, and image-editing applications is desirable.

Required Skills:

e Learning Authoring tools - Storyline, Rise, PPT,
Design tool basic knowledge - Photoshop, Illustrator

title: Graphic Designer
jobDescription:
Group Company: Harbinger Group

Designation: Graphic Designer

Office Location: Siddhant

Position description:

Create high-impact visual communication for digital learning, marketing, sales enablement, presentations, campaigns, and multimedia experiences. The role requires excellent visual-design craft, strong concept development, marketing-agency or creative-agency experience, and mandatory use of AI-assisted design tools to accelerate ideation and production without compromising originality, brand alignment, or quality.

Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Translate briefs, storyboards, campaign requirements, and brand guidelines into compelling visual concepts and polished design solutions.
  • Design high-fidelity course screens, presentations, pitch decks, infographics, social and campaign assets, banners, brochures, digital ads, email graphics, landing-page visuals, videos, and other brand collateral.
  • Develop visual concepts suitable for both learning and marketing contexts, balancing communication objectives, audience needs, brand positioning, and conversion or engagement goals.
  • Create consistent design systems covering typography, color, grid, hierarchy, spacing, iconography, imagery, illustration style, and reusable components.
  • Apply excellent composition, typography, image direction, information design, visual storytelling, and art-direction skills.
  • Interpret and enhance storyboards while preserving instructional intent and improving visual engagement, clarity, and production feasibility.
  • Define interaction states and developer handoff specifications, including default, hover, selected, visited, disabled, revealed, and responsive behaviors.
  • Create or direct original graphics, illustrations, icons, image composites, avatars, presentation templates, motion assets, and visual treatments.
  • Use AI tools as a mandatory part of visual-design work for ideation, mood boards, image generation, image enhancement, background creation, visual variations, layout exploration, and production acceleration.
  • Write effective prompts, refine AI outputs, maintain visual consistency, correct artifacts, and ensure outputs meet brand, copyright, privacy, and quality requirements.
  • Design for accessibility through readable contrast, legible typography, clear focus/selected states, non-color cues, and suitable alternatives for meaningful visual information.
  • Present design rationale confidently, incorporate feedback constructively, manage multiple assignments, and deliver accurately within agency-style timelines.
  • Conduct self-reviews and peer reviews for aesthetics, brand compliance, accessibility, accuracy, technical feasibility, and production readiness.

Reporting Team

  • Reporting Designation: Manager Multimedia, Visual Design
  • Reporting Department: Digital Publishing

Educational qualifications preferred

  • Category: Design
  • Field specialization: In visual communication, graphic design, applied arts, fine arts, interaction design, or a related discipline.
  • Degree: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience (BFA, GD Art, HFI, ATD)

Required work experience

  • Industry: marketing, advertising, digital, branding, or creative agency is required.
  • ROLE: Visual Designer
  • Years of experience: 4+

Key Performance Indicators: Designing content

Required Competencies:

  • Excellent visual-design skills with a strong portfolio demonstrating concept-led, contemporary, and highly polished work.
  • Strong agency-style creative thinking, visual exploration, art direction, and the ability to produce multiple quality concepts from an ambiguous brief.
  • Advanced understanding of branding, campaign design, digital marketing creatives, learning visualization, typography, color, composition, grid, hierarchy, and information design.
  • Ability to adapt a single visual idea across multiple formats and channels while maintaining campaign and brand consistency.
  • Ability to balance aesthetics with communication clarity, learning objectives, audience needs, accessibility, and production constraints.
  • Strong presentation, stakeholder communication, feedback interpretation, time management, and collaboration skills.
Required Knowledge: Visual Design, UX Design, Human Interaction

Required Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design, Figma, and Power Point; working knowledge of After Effects or other motion-design tools is desirable.
  • Mandatory proficiency with AI-assisted visual-design tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Leonardo AI, Chat GPT image generation, Ideogram, Canva AI, or equivalent platforms.
  • Demonstrated prompt-engineering skills and the ability to transform AI-generated concepts into polished, editable, brand-compliant final assets.
  • A strong portfolio covering marketing campaigns, brand collateral, presentations, infographics, digital learning screens, and AI-assisted visual work.
Work Environment Details: Hybrid

title: Multimedia Designer
jobDescription:
Group Company: Harbinger Group

Designation: Video Designer/Developer

Office Location: Siddhant

Position description: Conceptualize, design, animate, edit, and deliver professional learning, marketing, promotional, explainer, and corporate videos. The role requires strong visual storytelling, advanced Adobe After Effects capability, disciplined post-production skills, and mandatory use of AI tools for visual design and video development.


Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Interpret briefs, scripts, storyboards, brand guidelines, and learning or marketing objectives to define the most effective video treatment and production approach.
  • Create storyboards, style frames, animatics, mood boards, shot plans, and motion-design concepts before production.
  • Design and animate motion graphics, typography, icons, illustrations, transitions, UI demonstrations, infographics, charts, lower thirds, intros/outros, and branded visual systems in Adobe After Effects.
  • Edit video, audio, screen recordings, stock footage, presenter footage, AI-generated footage, and animation into clear, engaging narratives.
  • Use AI-assisted visual-design tools to generate and refine images, backgrounds, characters, storyboards, style frames, and other production assets.
  • Use AI video-development tools such as Synthesia, Runway, Adobe Firefly Video, Veo, Hey Gen, Pika, In Video AI, or equivalent platforms for presenter videos, generative footage, scene creation, localization, and production acceleration.
  • Create and manage AI avatars, synthetic voiceovers, captions, multilingual versions, and lip-synced or localized video outputs where required.
  • Apply professional pacing, composition, typography, transitions, sound design, color treatment, and animation principles.
  • Perform video cleanup, color correction, audio balancing, noise reduction, subtitle/caption integration, compression, and final mastering.
  • Optimize videos for LMS delivery, websites, social media, presentations, campaigns, and different screen sizes or aspect ratios.
  • Maintain organized source projects, compositions, naming conventions, linked assets, version control, and reusable motion templates.
  • Validate AI-generated content for accuracy, visual artifacts, continuity, brand fit, consent, privacy, licensing, and responsible-use requirements.
  • Perform self-QA for timing, synchronization, spelling, captions, audio levels, visual consistency, encoding, and playback quality.
  • Collaborate with instructional designers, visual designers, marketing teams, content specialists, voice artists, and project stakeholders.

Reporting Team

  • Reporting Designation: Manager - Multimedia and Visual Design

  • Reporting Department: Digital Publishing

Educational qualifications preferred

  • Category: Motion graphics, animation, film, multimedia, visual communication, or a related discipline.
  • Field specialization: Motion graphics, animation, film, multimedia, visual communication, or a related discipline.
  • Degree: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in motion graphics, animation, film, multimedia, visual communication, or a related discipline.

Required work experience

  • Industry: Motion graphics, animation, film, multimedia, visual communication, or a related discipline.
  • ROLE: Video Designer/Developer
  • Years of experience: 3 to 6

Required Competencies:

  • Advanced motion-design and compositing skills in Adobe After Effects are essential.
  • Strong visual storytelling, storyboarding, editing, animation timing, typography, composition, and design fundamentals.
  • Ability to select the right production approach: motion graphics, presenter-led, image-led, screen-capture, stock-footage, AI-generated, or hybrid.
  • Strong understanding of video formats, codecs, frame rates, resolutions, aspect ratios, audio standards, captions, and platform-specific outputs.
  • Ability to transform AI-generated footage and assets into coherent, polished, production-ready videos rather than relying on unedited AI outputs.
  • Strong creative judgment, attention to detail, ownership, communication, estimation, and ability to manage multiple videos against deadlines.
Required Skills:
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects; strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and audio-editing tools.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with AI visual-design and AI video-development tools, including Synthesia or a comparable avatar-video platform.
  • Experience with tools such as Runway, Adobe Firefly, Veo, Hey Gen, Pika, In Video AI, Eleven Labs, Murf, Descript, or equivalent platforms is strongly preferred.
  • A strong showreel or portfolio demonstrating motion graphics, explainers, learning videos, marketing videos, AI-assisted production, and end-to-end post-production quality.

Work Environment Details: Hybrid

title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription:
We’re seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a strong command of .Net and Angular 18 and modern frontend technologies. The ideal candidate will excel in both technical execution and collaborative leadership, demonstrating excellent communication skills and an Agile mindset. You’ll play a critical role in designing, developing, and optimizing our web applications while mentoring junior developers and influencing technical decisions.


1. Design and implement reusable components and responsive UI using Angular Material UI 14.2.5 and FAST.
2. Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using .NET 10.0 and .NET Core Microservices.
3. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in C# 14 following best practices.
4. Develop event-driven systems with Azure Service Bus for message brokering and Azure Data Factory for ETL processes.
5. Implement logging, error handling, and monitoring using Serilog, NLog, and Sonar Cloud for static code analysis.
6. Write unit and end-to-end tests with Jest to ensure reliable, high-quality software.
7. Manage dependencies with Nu Get and collaborate through CI/CD pipelines.
8. Participate in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups, while collaborating with frontend, Dev Ops, and product teams.
9. Communicate technical ideas and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ensure code quality with ESLint, Prettier, and SCSS for clean, maintainable styling.
10. Own the build pipeline — optimize performance using NPM, Gulp, and Webpack.
11. Collaborate in an Agile environment, participating in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
12. Mentor and guide junior developers, promoting best practices and technical excellence.
13. Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and product owners to translate requirements into deliverables.
14. Continuously improve processes, suggesting and implementing innovative solutions for better performance and maintainability.


1. 5+ years of experience in frontend and backend development, with a strong portfolio showcasing Angular 18 projects and with a strong focus on .NET Core Microservices.
2. Proficiency in Type Script, SCSS, Angular Material, and frontend design patterns.
3. Proficiency in C# 14 and experience building RESTful APIs and Graph QL services.
4. Strong understanding of unit testing and E2E testing frameworks: Jest, Cypress.
5. Expertise in Azure services — Functions, Web Apps, Redis Cache, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Database.
6. Knowledge of containers and container orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
7. Proven leadership experience — mentoring developers and contributing to technical decisions.
8. Excellent communication skills — ability to explain complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
9. Agile mindset — comfortable working in sprints, adapting to changes, and collaborating cross-functionally.
10. Excellent communication skills — able to explain complex backend concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
11. Strong problem-solving mindset with a passion for building high-performance, resilient systems.
12. Good to have e-learning domain knowledge.
